# AGIX Technologies

> > AGIX Technologies delivers enterprise AI solutions for hospitality, fintech, and smart kitchen industries, driving revenue optimization, guest personalization, and conversational AI experiences.

AGIX Technologies specializes in building custom AI systems for Fortune 500 companies and innovative startups. Their solutions span dynamic pricing engines, conversational AI assistants, and IoT-enabled smart experiences, with proven results including 4.7% RevPAR increases for Hilton Hotels and 57% support volume reduction for Dave fintech.
